description_en: Queries video transcoding summary of one or more audio or video files by their IDs, including video transcoding status and transcoding progress
description_zh: 调用本接口根据音视频ID查询音视频转码摘要，包括音视频转码状态、转码进展等汇总信息
name: GetTranscodeSummary

parameters.help_en:
The audio or video IDs. You can specify a maximum of 10 IDs, separated by commas (,). You can obtain the audio or video ID by using the following methods:
For audio or video files uploaded through the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the audio or video ID.
Obtain the video ID from the value of the VideoId parameter returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation when you request an upload URL and credential.
After the audio or video file is uploaded, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频ID。最多支持10个ID，多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。音/视频ID可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的音/视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看音/视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口获取上传地址和凭证时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
音/视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: video_ids

NonExistVideoIds.description_en: The IDs of audio or video files that do not exist

items.description_en: The IDs of audio or video files that do not exist

TranscodeSummaryList.description_en: The video transcoding summary list of audio or video files
TranscodeSummaryList.description_zh: 音/视频转码基础信息列表

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding task was complete. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CompleteTime.description_zh: 转码任务完成时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding task was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: 转码任务创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

TranscodeJobInfoSummaryList.description_en: The list of transcoding job summaries
TranscodeJobInfoSummaryList.description_zh: 转码作业摘要信息列表

Bitrate.description_en: The average bitrate of the transcoded video output. Unit: Kbps
Bitrate.description_zh: 转码输出视频的平均码率。单位：Kbps

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding job was complete. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CompleteTime.description_zh: 转码作业完成时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding job was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: 转码作业创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Duration.description_en: The duration of the transcoded video output. Unit: seconds
Duration.description_zh: 转码输出视频时长。单位：秒

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the transcoding job failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the transcoding job failed

Filesize.description_en: The file size of the transcoded video output. Unit: bytes
Filesize.description_zh: 转码输出视频的文件大小。单位：Byte

Format.description_en: The container format of the transcoded video output
Format.description_zh: 转码输出视频的封装格式

Fps.description_en: The frame rate of the transcoded video output. Unit: frames per second
Fps.description_zh: 转码输出视频的帧率。单位：帧/秒

Height.description_en: The height of the transcoded video output. Unit: px
Height.description_zh: 转码输出视频的画面高。单位：px

TranscodeJobStatus.description_en:
The status of the transcoding job. Valid values:

Transcoding: The transcoding job is in progress.
TranscodeSuccess: The transcoding job is successful.
TranscodeFail: The transcoding job failed
TranscodeJobStatus.description_zh:
转码作业状态。取值：

Transcoding：转码中。
TranscodeSuccess：转码成功。
TranscodeFail：转码失败

TranscodeTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template used

WatermarkIdList.description_en: The list of watermarks used for transcoding

items.description_en: The list of watermarks used for transcoding

Width.description_en: The width of the transcoded video output. Unit: px
Width.description_zh: 转码输出视频的画面宽。单位：px

TranscodeStatus.description_en:
The transcoding status. Valid values:

Processing: The transcoding task is in progress.
Partial: The transcoding task is partially complete.
CompleteAllSucc: All transcoding jobs are complete and successful.
CompleteAllFail: All transcoding jobs are complete but all failed. If the source file has issues, no transcoding jobs are initiated and the entire transcoding task fails.
CompletePartialSucc: All transcoding jobs are complete but only some are successful
TranscodeStatus.description_zh:
转码处理状态。取值：

Processing：处理中。
Partial：部分转码完成。
CompleteAllSucc：全部处理完成，且全部转码成功。
CompleteAllFail：全部处理完成，且全部转码失败，如果源片有问题，则不会发起任何转码作业，整个转码任务失败。
CompletePartialSucc：全部转码完成，但仅部分转码成功

TranscodeTemplateGroupId.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template group used for transcoding
